column1: # clues.tsv for ft_strncat — hints only, never answers.
strncat appends at most nb bytes of src, then always adds a terminator. What should happen when nb is 0, and when nb is larger than src's length? Does your result always end properly?
This buffer is 'X'-filled past the terminator. After appending nb bytes, is the new terminator placed correctly so no leftover bytes appear?
